JARA TAFSEEER SE BATAYE Narrated with sound chains from Dhu Mikhbar al-Najashi: " You will make a firm truce with the Romans (al-Rum) until you and they wage a campaign against an enemy that is attacking them. You will be granted victory and great spoils. Then you will alight in a plain surrounded by hills. There, someone among the Romans shall say: 'The Cross has overcome!' whereupon someone among the Muslims shall say: 'Nay, Allah has overcome!' and shall go and break the cross. The Romans shall kill him, then the Muslims shall take up their arms and the two sides shall fall upon each other. Allah shall grant martyrdom to that group of Muslims. After that the Romans shall say to their leader: 'We shall relieve you of the Arabs,' and they shall gather up for the great battle. They shall come to you under eighty flags (nations), each flag (nation) gathering 12,000 troops." (Abu Dawud, Kitab al-Jihad - Vol. 3/7 - No. 2479, Ahmad, Ibn Majah) 2788 views Q. answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Hadith & Sunnah Question ID: 157492 Country: India Title: I want to confirm the authenticity of the Hadith regarding the 99 names of Allah. Whether the 99 names written are part of the original Hadith? Please check. Question: I want to confirm the authenticity of the Hadith regarding the 99 names of Allah. Whether the 99 names written are part of the original Hadith? Please check. Answer ID: 157492 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 430/329/SN=4/1439) Ninety nine names of Allah are proved from Sahih Hadith. It is recorded in Bukhari: Allah has ninety nine names, i.e. one-hundred minus one, and whoever remembers them will go to Paradise. عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ : ‏ إِنَّ لِلَّهِ تِسْعَةً وَتِسْعِينَ اسْمَا مِائَةً إِلاَّ وَاحِدًا مَنْ أَحْصَاهَا دَخَلَ الْجَنَّةَ‏‏.‏(بخارى، رقم: 2736) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
